sentences.zh: 神宗元豐六年十一月二日，帝將親郊，奉仁宗、英宗徽號冊寶於太廟。

translations.literal: On the second day of the eleventh month of the sixth year of Yuanfeng under Shenzong, as the emperor was about to perform personal suburban sacrifice, he presented Renzong and Yingzong's honorific title tablets and seals at the Imperial Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the second day of the eleventh month in the sixth year of Yuanfeng (1083), as the emperor was about to perform the suburban sacrifice in person, he presented Renzong and Yingzong's honorific title tablets and seals at the Imperial Temple.

sentences.zh: 是日晚，齋於大慶殿。

translations.literal: That evening he fasted at the Daqing Hall.
translations.idiomatic: That evening he fasted at the Daqing Hall.

sentences.zh: 三日，薦享于景靈宮，齋於太廟。

translations.literal: On the third day, offerings at Jingling Palace; he fasted at the Imperial Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the third day, he presented offerings at Jingling Palace and fasted at the Imperial Temple.

sentences.zh: 四日，朝享七室，齋於南郊之青城。

translations.literal: On the fourth day, morning enjoyment at the seven chambers; he fasted at the Green City of the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On the fourth day, he worshipped at the seven temple chambers and fasted at the Green City of the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 五日冬至，祀昊天上帝於圜丘，以太祖配。

translations.literal: On the fifth day, the winter solstice, Vast Heaven Supreme Thearch was sacrificed to at the Round Mound, with Taizu as match.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifth day, the winter solstice, he sacrificed to Vast Heaven Supreme Thearch at the Round Mound with Taizu as the matching spirit.

sentences.zh: 是日，帝服靴袍，乘輦至大次。

translations.literal: That day the emperor wore boots and robe, rode the imperial carriage to the great tent.
translations.idiomatic: That day the emperor wore boots and robe and rode the imperial carriage to the great tent.

sentences.zh: 有司請行禮。

translations.literal: The responsible officials requested that the rites proceed.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible officials requested that the rites proceed.

sentences.zh: 服大裘，被袞冕以出，至壇中壝門外，殿中監進大圭，帝執以入，宮架樂作，至午階下版位，西向立，樂止。

translations.literal: He donned the great fur robe, put on dark robes and cap to emerge, reached outside the middle enclosure gate of the altar; the Palace Director presented the great scepter; the emperor took it to enter; palace music began; he reached the tablet position below the south stairway, stood facing west; the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: He donned the great fur robe and dark robes and cap, emerged to outside the middle enclosure gate of the altar; the Palace Director presented the great scepter; the emperor took it and entered as palace music began; he reached the tablet position below the south stairway, stood facing west, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 禮儀使贊曰：「有司謹具，請行事。

translations.literal: The Commissioner of Rites intoned: "The responsible officials have reverently prepared — we request that the rites proceed.
translations.idiomatic: The Commissioner of Rites intoned: "The responsible officials have reverently prepared — we request that the rites proceed.

sentences.zh: 」宮架奏《景安》之樂，文舞作六成，止，帝再拜，詣罍洗，宮架樂作，至洗南北向，樂止。

translations.literal: " Palace music performed the Jing'an piece; civil dancers performed six sections and stopped; the emperor bowed twice, proceeded to the urn for washing; palace music began; he reached the wash, stood facing south; the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: " Palace music performed the Jing'an piece; civil dancers performed six sections and stopped; the emperor bowed twice and proceeded to the urn for washing; palace music began; he reached the wash, stood facing south, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 帝搢圭，盥帨訖，樂作，至壇下，樂止。

translations.literal: The emperor inserted the scepter, finished washing hands and drying with the towel; music began; he reached below the altar; music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor inserted the scepter, finished washing his hands and drying them; music began; he reached the foot of the altar and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 升午階，登歌樂作，至壇上，樂止。

translations.literal: He ascended the south stairway; ascending hymn music began; he reached the top of the altar; music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: He ascended the south stairway as ascending hymn music began; he reached the top of the altar and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 殿中監進鎮圭，《嘉安》樂作，詣上帝神坐前，北向跪，奠鎮圭於繅藉，執大圭，俯伏，興，搢圭跪，三上香，奠玉幣，執圭，俯伏，興，再拜。

translations.literal: The Palace Director presented the securing scepter; the Jia'an music began; he proceeded before the Supreme Thearch's spirit seat, knelt facing north, placed the securing scepter on the silk mat, took the great scepter, prostrated himself, rose, inserted the scepter and knelt, offered incense three times, presented jade and silk, took the scepter, prostrated himself, rose, bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Director presented the securing scepter; the Jia'an music began; he proceeded before the Supreme Thearch's spirit seat, knelt facing north, placed the securing scepter on the silk mat, took the great scepter, prostrated himself, rose, inserted the scepter and knelt, offered incense three times, presented jade and silk, took the scepter, prostrated himself again, rose, and bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 內侍舉鎮圭授殿中監，樂止。

translations.literal: The inner attendant raised the securing scepter and handed it to the Palace Director; the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: The inner attendant raised the securing scepter and handed it to the Palace Director, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 《廣安》樂作，詣太祖神坐前，東向，奠圭幣如上帝儀。

translations.literal: The Guang'an music began; he proceeded before Taizu's spirit seat, facing east, presenting scepter and silk as at the Supreme Thearch's ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: The Guang'an music began; he proceeded before Taizu's spirit seat, facing east, and presented the scepter and silk as at the Supreme Thearch's ceremony.

sentences.zh: 登歌樂作，帝降壇，樂止。

translations.literal: Ascending hymn music began; the emperor descended the altar; the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending hymn music began; the emperor descended the altar, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 宮架樂作，還位，西向立，樂止。

translations.literal: Palace music began; he returned to his position, stood facing west; the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Palace music began; he returned to his position, stood facing west, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 禮部尚書、戶部尚書以下奉饌俎，宮架《豐安》樂作，奉奠訖，樂止。

translations.literal: The Minister of Rites, Minister of Revenue, and those below presented food trays; palace music performed the Feng'an piece; the presentation was complete; the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: The Minister of Rites, Minister of Revenue, and those below presented the food trays; palace music performed the Feng'an piece; when the presentation was complete, the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 再詣罍洗，帝搢大圭，盥帨，洗爵拭爵訖，執大圭，宮架樂作，至壇下，樂止。

translations.literal: He again proceeded to the urn for washing; the emperor inserted the great scepter, washed hands and dried with the towel, washed and wiped the goblet; taking the great scepter, palace music began; he reached below the altar; the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: He again proceeded to the urn for washing; the emperor inserted the great scepter, washed his hands and dried them, washed and wiped the goblet; taking the great scepter, he proceeded as palace music began to the foot of the altar, where the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 升自午階，登歌樂作，至壇上，樂止。

translations.literal: He ascended the south stairway; ascending hymn music began; he reached the top of the altar; the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: He ascended the south stairway as ascending hymn music began; he reached the top of the altar, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 登歌《禧安》樂作，詣上帝神坐前，搢圭跪，執爵祭酒，三奠訖，執圭，俯伏，興，樂止。

translations.literal: Ascending hymn music performed the Xi'an piece; he proceeded before the Supreme Thearch's spirit seat, inserted the scepter and knelt, took the goblet and offered libation wine, three presentations complete; took the scepter, prostrated himself, rose; the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending hymn music performed the Xi'an piece; he proceeded before the Supreme Thearch's spirit seat, inserted the scepter and knelt, took the goblet and offered libation wine three times; he took the scepter, prostrated himself, rose, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 太祝讀冊，帝再拜訖，樂作。

translations.literal: The chief invoker read the document; the emperor bowed twice; the music began.
translations.idiomatic: The chief invoker read the prayer text; the emperor bowed twice, and the music began.

sentences.zh: 次詣太祖神坐前，如前儀。

translations.literal: Next he proceeded before Taizu's spirit seat, following the previous ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: Next he proceeded before Taizu's spirit seat, following the same ceremony.

sentences.zh: 登歌樂作，帝降自午階，樂止。

translations.literal: Ascending hymn music began; the emperor descended the south stairway; the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending hymn music began; the emperor descended the south stairway, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 宮架樂作，還位，西向立，樂止。

translations.literal: Palace music began; he returned to his position, stood facing west; the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Palace music began; he returned to his position, stood facing west, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 文舞退，武舞進，宮架《正安》之樂作，樂止。

translations.literal: Civil dancers withdrew, martial dancers advanced; palace music performed the Zheng'an piece; the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: The civil dancers withdrew and the martial dancers advanced; palace music performed the Zheng'an piece, then ceased.

sentences.zh: 亞獻盥帨訖，《正安》樂作，禮畢，樂止。

translations.literal: The secondary offering official finished washing hands and drying with the towel; the Zheng'an music began; the rites were complete; the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: The secondary offering official finished washing his hands and drying them; the Zheng'an music began; when the rites were complete, the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 終獻行禮並如上儀，獻畢，宮架樂作，帝升自午階，樂止。

translations.literal: The final offering performed the rites all as above; when the offerings were complete, palace music began; the emperor ascended the south stairway; the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: The final offering performed the rites as above; when the offerings were complete, palace music began; the emperor ascended the south stairway, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 登歌樂作，至飲福位，樂止。

translations.literal: Ascending hymn music began; he reached the Drinking Blessings position; the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending hymn music began; he reached the Drinking Blessings position, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 《禧安》樂作，帝再拜，搢圭跪，受爵，祭酒三，啐酒，奠爵，受俎，奠俎，受摶黍豆，再受爵，飲福訖，奠爵，執圭，俯伏，興，再拜，樂作。

translations.literal: The Xi'an music began; the emperor bowed twice, inserted the scepter and knelt, received the goblet, offered libation wine three times, sipped the wine, placed the goblet, received the tray, placed the tray, received the millet and beans, received the goblet again, finished drinking blessings, placed the goblet, took the scepter, prostrated himself, rose, bowed twice; the music began.
translations.idiomatic: The Xi'an music began; the emperor bowed twice, inserted the scepter and knelt, received the goblet, offered libation wine three times, sipped the wine, and placed the goblet; he received the tray and placed it, received the millet and beans, received the goblet again and finished drinking blessings; he placed the goblet, took the scepter, prostrated himself, rose, bowed twice, and the music began.

sentences.zh: 帝降，還位如前儀。

translations.literal: The emperor descended and returned to his position as in the previous ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor descended and returned to his position as before.

sentences.zh: 禮部、戶部尚書徹俎豆，禮直官曰：「賜胙行事。

translations.literal: The Ministers of Rites and Revenue withdrew the trays and beans; the ritual officer stated: "Bestow sacrificial meat and proceed with the rites.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministers of Rites and Revenue withdrew the trays and beans; the ritual officer announced: "Bestow the sacrificial meat and proceed with the rites.

sentences.zh: 」陪祀官再拜，宮架《宴安》樂作，一成止。

translations.literal: " Attendant sacrifice officials bowed twice; palace music performed the Yan'an piece; one section and stop.
translations.idiomatic: " The attendant sacrifice officials bowed twice; palace music performed the Yan'an piece for one section and stopped.

sentences.zh: 宮架樂作，帝詣望燎位，南向立，樂止。

translations.literal: Palace music began; the emperor proceeded to the gazing fire position, stood facing south; the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Palace music began; the emperor proceeded to the gazing fire position, stood facing south, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 禮直官曰：「可燎。

translations.literal: The ritual officer stated: "The fire may be kindled.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual officer announced: "The fire may be kindled.

sentences.zh: 」俟火燎半柴，禮儀使跪奏：「禮畢。

translations.literal: " When the fire had burned half the firewood, the Commissioner of Rites knelt and reported: "The rites are complete.
translations.idiomatic: " When the fire had burned half the firewood, the Commissioner of Rites knelt and reported: "The rites are complete.

sentences.zh: 」宮架樂作，帝出中壝門，殿中監受大圭，歸大次，樂止。

translations.literal: " Palace music began; the emperor exited the middle enclosure gate; the Palace Director received the great scepter; he returned to the great tent; the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: " Palace music began; the emperor exited the middle enclosure gate; the Palace Director received the great scepter; he returned to the great tent, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 有司奏解嚴。

translations.literal: The responsible officials reported release of vigilance.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible officials announced release of vigilance.

sentences.zh: 帝乘輿還青城，百官稱賀於端誠殿。

translations.literal: The emperor rode the imperial carriage back to the Green City; all officials offered congratulations at the Duanqing Hall.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rode the imperial carriage back to the Green City, and all officials offered congratulations at the Duanqing Hall.

sentences.zh: 有司轉仗衛，奏中嚴外辦。

translations.literal: The responsible officials shifted the guard regalia and reported inner vigilance and outer readiness.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible officials shifted the guard regalia and announced inner vigilance and outer readiness.

sentences.zh: 帝服通天冠、絳紗袍，乘輿以出。

translations.literal: The emperor wore the Tongtian crown and crimson gauze robe, and rode the imperial carriage to emerge.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wore the Tongtian crown and crimson gauze robe and rode the imperial carriage forth.

sentences.zh: 至玉輅所，侍中跪請降輿升輅。

translations.literal: At the jade carriage station, the Palace Attendant knelt and requested that he descend the carriage and ascend the jade carriage.
translations.idiomatic: At the jade carriage station, the Palace Attendant knelt and requested that he descend the carriage and ascend the jade carriage.

sentences.zh: 帝升輅，門下侍郎奏請進行，又奏請少駐，侍臣乘馬，將至宣德門，奏《采薺》一曲，入門，樂止。

translations.literal: The emperor ascended the jade carriage; the Vice Chancellery Attendant reported requesting to proceed, then reported requesting a brief halt; attendant ministers rode horses; as they neared the Xuande Gate, they performed one piece of the Caixi melody; entering the gate, the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ascended the jade carriage; the Vice Chancellery Attendant requested that they proceed, then requested a brief halt; attendant ministers rode on horseback; as they neared the Xuande Gate, they performed the Caixi melody; upon entering the gate, the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 侍中請降輅赴幄次，有司奏解嚴。

translations.literal: The Palace Attendant requested descending the jade carriage to proceed to the tent quarters; the responsible officials reported release of vigilance.
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Attendant requested that he descend the jade carriage to proceed to the tent quarters; the responsible officials announced release of vigilance.

sentences.zh: 帝常服，乘輿禦宣德門，肆赦，群臣稱賀如常儀。

translations.literal: The emperor in ordinary dress rode the imperial carriage to ascend the Xuande Gate, proclaimed a general amnesty; the host of ministers offered congratulations according to ordinary protocol.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor in ordinary dress rode the imperial carriage to the Xuande Gate, proclaimed a general amnesty, and the host of ministers offered congratulations according to ordinary protocol.

sentences.zh: 神宗之嗣位也，英宗之喪未除。

translations.literal: When Shenzong succeeded to the throne, Yingzong's mourning had not yet been concluded.
translations.idiomatic: When Shenzong succeeded to the throne, mourning for Yingzong had not yet been concluded.

sentences.zh: 是歲當郊，帝以為疑，以問講讀官王珪、司馬光、王安石，皆對以不當廢。

translations.literal: That year suburban sacrifice was due; the emperor was uncertain and asked the lecture and reading officials Wang Gui, Sima Guang, and Wang Anshi — all replied that it should not be abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: That year suburban sacrifice was due; the emperor was uncertain and asked the lecture and reading officials Wang Gui, Sima Guang, and Wang Anshi — all replied that it should not be abandoned.

sentences.zh: 珪又謂：「'喪三年不祭，惟祭天地、社稷，為越紼而行事。

translations.literal: Gui further stated: "'During three years of mourning one does not sacrifice — only Heaven and Earth and the altars of soil and grain are sacrificed to, acting by overriding the mourning cords.
translations.idiomatic: Gui further argued: "During three years of mourning one does not perform sacrifices — except to Heaven and Earth and the altars of soil and grain, acting by overriding the mourning cords.

sentences.zh: '《傳》謂：'不敢以卑廢尊也。

translations.literal: ' The Commentary states: 'One dare not let the humble abolish the exalted.
translations.idiomatic: " The Commentary states: "One dare not let the humble abolish the exalted.

sentences.zh: '景德二年，真宗居明德太后之喪，即易月而服除。

translations.literal: ' In the second year of Jingde, Zhenzong was in mourning for Empress Dowager Mingde — he changed the month and concluded mourning.
translations.idiomatic: " In the second year of Jingde, Zhenzong was in mourning for Empress Dowager Mingde — he shortened the mourning period and concluded it.

sentences.zh: 明年遂享太廟，而合祀天地於圜丘。

translations.literal: The next year he then enjoyed the Imperial Temple, and jointly sacrificed to Heaven and Earth at the Round Mound.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he worshipped at the Imperial Temple and jointly sacrificed to Heaven and Earth at the Round Mound.

sentences.zh: 請冬至行郊廟之禮，其服冕、車輅、儀物、音樂緣神事者皆不可廢。

translations.literal: We request performing suburban and temple rites at the winter solstice; dark robes and cap, carriages, ritual objects, and music pertaining to divine affairs — all cannot be abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: We request performing the suburban and temple rites at the winter solstice; the dark robes and cap, carriages, ritual objects, and music pertaining to divine affairs must none of them be abandoned.

sentences.zh: 」詔用景德故事，惟郊廟及景靈宮禮神用樂，鹵簿鼓吹及樓前宮架、諸軍音樂，皆備而不作，警場止鳴金鉦、鼓角，仍罷諸軍呈閱騎隊。

translations.literal: " An edict adopted the Jingde precedent: only at suburban sacrifice, temple, and Jingling Palace, when sacrificing to spirits, was music used; imperial escort wind music, palace music before the tower, and military music — all were prepared but not performed; the alert ground sounded only gold cymbals and horns and drums; military cavalry review formations were still suspended.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict adopted the Jingde precedent: music was used only at suburban sacrifice, the temple, and Jingling Palace when sacrificing to spirits; imperial escort wind music, palace music before the tower, and military music were all prepared but not performed; the alert ground sounded only gold cymbals, horns, and drums; and military cavalry review formations were suspended.

sentences.zh: 故事，齋宿必禦樓警嚴，幸後苑觀花，作水戲，至是悉罷之。

translations.literal: By precedent, during fasting lodging one must ascend the tower for vigilance, visit the rear garden to view flowers, perform water games — all were at this time abolished.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent, during fasting one ascended the tower for vigilance, visited the rear garden to view flowers, and performed water games — all of which were abolished on this occasion.

sentences.zh: 有司言：「故事，當謁謝於祖宗神禦殿，獻享月吉禮，以禮官攝。

translations.literal: The responsible officials stated: "By precedent, one should pay respects and give thanks at the spirit halls of the ancestors, presenting the monthly auspicious offering — to be performed by ritual officials by proxy.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible officials reported: "By precedent, the emperor should pay respects and give thanks at the spirit halls of the ancestors and present the monthly auspicious offering — to be performed by ritual officials by proxy.

sentences.zh: 」詔遣輔臣仍罷詣佛寺。

translations.literal: " An edict dispatched chief ministers and still abolished visits to Buddhist temples.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict dispatched chief ministers in his stead and abolished visits to Buddhist temples as well.

sentences.zh: 是後國有故，皆遣輔臣。

translations.literal: Thereafter when the state had mourning affairs, chief ministers were always dispatched.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, whenever the state was in mourning, chief ministers were dispatched in the emperor's stead.

sentences.zh: 高宗紹興十二年，臣僚言：「自南巡以來，三歲之祀，獨於明堂，而郊天之禮未舉，來歲乞行大禮。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Shaoxing under Gaozong, officials stated: "Since the southern tour, the three-year sacrifices have been performed only at the Bright Hall, while sacrifice to Heaven at the suburb has not been performed — next year we request performing the great rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of Shaoxing (1142), officials observed: "Since the southern relocation, the triennial sacrifices have been performed only at the Bright Hall, while sacrifice to Heaven at the suburb has not been performed — we request performing the great rites next year.

sentences.zh: 」詔建圜壇于臨安府行宮東城之外，自是凡六郊焉。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered building the Round Mound outside the eastern wall of the traveling palace in Lin'an Prefecture; from then on suburban sacrifices were performed six times in all.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict ordered the Round Mound built outside the eastern wall of the traveling palace in Lin'an Prefecture; from then on six suburban sacrifices were performed in all.

sentences.zh: 孝宗隆興二年，詔曰：「聯恭覽國史，太祖乾德詔書有云：'務從省約，無至勞煩。

translations.literal: In the second year of Longxing under Xiaozong, an edict stated: "We have reverently reviewed the dynastic history; Taizu's Qiande edict states: 'Strive for economy and simplicity; do not reach the point of labor and trouble.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Longxing (1164), an edict stated: "We have reverently reviewed the dynastic history; Taizu's Qiande edict declares: "Strive for economy and simplicity; do not impose undue labor and trouble.

sentences.zh: '仰見事天之誠，愛民之仁，所以垂萬世之統者在是。

translations.literal: ' Looking up one sees sincerity in serving Heaven and benevolence in loving the people — that by which the succession is handed down for ten thousand generations lies herein.
translations.idiomatic: " In this one sees sincerity in serving Heaven and benevolence in loving the people — the foundation on which the succession is handed down for all generations.

sentences.zh: 今歲郊見，可令有司，除禮物、軍賞，其餘並從省約。

translations.literal: This year's suburban audience — let the responsible officials, apart from ritual gifts and military rewards, reduce everything else to economy.
translations.idiomatic: For this year's suburban audience, let the responsible officials, apart from ritual gifts and military rewards, reduce everything else to economy.

sentences.zh: 初降詔以十一月行事，以冬至適在晦日，以至道典故，改用獻歲上辛，遂改來年元為乾道。

translations.literal: Initially the edict scheduled the rites for the eleventh month; because the winter solstice fell on the last day of the month, following the Zhidao precedent, it was changed to upper xin of the offering year; the next year's era name was then changed to Qiandao.
translations.idiomatic: Initially the edict scheduled the rites for the eleventh month; because the winter solstice fell on the last day of the month, following the Zhidao precedent it was changed to the upper xin day of the offering year, and the next year's era name was changed to Qiandao.

sentences.zh: 乃以正月一日有事南郊，禮成，進胙于德壽宮，以牛腥體肩三、臂上臑二。

translations.literal: Thus on the first day of the first month the Southern Suburb rites were performed; when the rites were complete, sacrificial meat was presented at the Deshou Palace — three pieces of raw beef shoulder and two of arm and shank.
translations.idiomatic: Thus on the first day of the first month the Southern Suburb rites were performed; when the rites were complete, sacrificial meat was presented at the Deshou Palace — three pieces of raw beef shoulder and two of arm and shank.

sentences.zh: 導駕官自端誠殿簪花從駕至德壽宮上壽，飲福稱賀，陳設儀注，並同上壽禮。

translations.literal: Escort officials from the Duanqing Hall wore flowers in their hair and followed the imperial carriage to Deshou Palace to offer longevity wishes; drinking blessings and offering congratulations; the arrangements and protocol all followed the longevity-wishing ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: Escort officials from the Duanqing Hall wore flowers in their hair and followed the imperial carriage to Deshou Palace to offer longevity wishes, drinking blessings and congratulations; the arrangements and protocol all followed the longevity-wishing ceremony.

sentences.zh: 皇帝致詞曰：「皇帝臣某言：享帝合宮，受天純嘏，臣某與百僚不勝大慶，謹上千萬歲壽。

translations.literal: The emperor's address stated: "The emperor your subject so-and-so states: Having enjoyed the Thearch at the Bright Hall, receiving Heaven's pure blessing — your subject and the hundred officials, unable to contain our great rejoicing, respectfully offer wishes for ten thousand years of life.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's address stated: "The emperor your subject states: Having worshipped the Thearch at the Bright Hall and received Heaven's pure blessing — your subject together with the hundred officials, unable to contain our great rejoicing, respectfully offer wishes for ten thousand years of life.

sentences.zh: 」自後郊祀、明堂進胙飲福，並如上儀。

translations.literal: " Thereafter at suburban sacrifice and Bright Hall, presenting sacrificial meat and drinking blessings all followed the above ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereafter, presenting sacrificial meat and drinking blessings at suburban sacrifice and the Bright Hall all followed this ceremony.

sentences.zh: 光宗紹熙二年十一月郊，以值雨，行禮於望祭殿。

translations.literal: At the suburban sacrifice in the eleventh month of the second year of Shaoxi under Guangzong, because of rain, the rites were performed at the Hall of Gazing Sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: At the suburban sacrifice in the eleventh month of the second year of Shaoxi (1191), because of rain, the rites were performed at the Hall of Gazing Sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 帝遂感疾。

translations.literal: The emperor then fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then fell ill.

sentences.zh: 理宗四十一年，一郊而已。

translations.literal: In forty-one years under Lizong, only one suburban sacrifice was performed.
translations.idiomatic: In forty-one years under Lizong, only one suburban sacrifice was performed.

sentences.zh: 度宗鹹淳二年，權工部尚書趙汝暨等奏：「今歲大禮，正在先帝大祥之後，臣等竊惟帝王受命，郊見天地，不可緩也。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianchun under Duzong, Acting Minister of Works Zhao Ruji and others memorialized: "This year's great rites fall just after the former emperor's da xiang mourning — we your subjects reflect that when a sovereign receives the Mandate, suburban audience with Heaven and Earth cannot be delayed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xianchun (1266), Acting Minister of Works Zhao Ruji and others memorialized: "This year's great rites fall just after the former emperor's da xiang mourning — we reflect that when a sovereign receives the Mandate, suburban audience with Heaven and Earth cannot be delayed.

sentences.zh: 古者有改元即郊，不用前郊三年為計。

translations.literal: In antiquity some changed the era name and immediately performed suburban sacrifice, not calculating from the previous suburb's three years.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity some performed suburban sacrifice immediately upon changing the era name, without calculating from the previous suburb's three-year interval.

sentences.zh: 況今適在當郊之歲，既逾大祥之期，圜丘之祀，豈容不舉？

translations.literal: Moreover, now it happens to be the year when suburban sacrifice is due; the da xiang period has already passed — how can sacrifice at the Round Mound be allowed not to be performed?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, this is precisely the year when suburban sacrifice is due, and the da xiang period has already passed — how can the Round Mound sacrifice be omitted?

sentences.zh: 」於是降禮，以十一月十七日款謁南郊，適太史院言：「十六日太陰交蝕。

translations.literal: " Thereupon the rites were scheduled for reverent audience at the Southern Suburb on the seventeenth day of the eleventh month; just then the Astronomical Bureau stated: "On the sixteenth day the moon will undergo eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: " The rites were accordingly scheduled for reverent audience at the Southern Suburb on the seventeenth day of the eleventh month; just then the Astronomical Bureau reported: "On the sixteenth day there will be a lunar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 」遂改來年正月一日南郊行禮，太常寺言：「皇帝既已從吉，請依儀用樂。

translations.literal: " It was then changed to the first day of the first month of the following year for Southern Suburb rites; the Court of Imperial Sacrifices stated: "Since the emperor has already concluded mourning, we request using music according to the protocol.
translations.idiomatic: " The rites were then moved to the first day of the first month of the following year; the Court of Imperial Sacrifices reported: "Since the emperor has already concluded mourning, we request using music according to protocol.

sentences.zh: 其十二月二十九日朝獻景靈宮，三十日朝享太廟，尚在禫制之內，所有迎神、奠幣、酌獻、送神作樂外，其盥洗升降行步等樂，備而不作。」

translations.literal: On the twenty-ninth day of the twelfth month, morning presentation at Jingling Palace; on the thirtieth, morning enjoyment at the Imperial Temple — still within the chan mourning period; apart from music for welcoming spirits, presenting silks, pouring offerings, and sending off spirits, music for washing, ascending, descending, and walking — all prepared but not performed."
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-ninth day of the twelfth month came morning presentation at Jingling Palace; on the thirtieth, morning worship at the Imperial Temple — still within the chan mourning period; apart from music for welcoming spirits, presenting silks, pouring offerings, and sending off spirits, music for washing, ascending, descending, and walking was all prepared but not performed."
